summary: A notice that the Network Working Group meeting at MIT's Project MAC moved ahead two weeks, to October 10 through 14, 1971. It also sets the theme: with implementation largely done, the group's concern was shifting from protocols toward how the network is actually used.

eli5.summary: The big meeting got pushed back two weeks. This note also says the group is finished building the basics and now wants to talk about what people can do with the network.
